title: Move it shipping
titleCn: Move it 国际行李托运服务咨询

paragraphs.text: Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time.
Listen carefully and answer questions one to six.
Hi. I'd like a few more details about your services, please.

I've been on your website looking into sending some things abroad when I go away to study next term. I see that you provide special empty boxes so that I can pack them myself and you then transport them.
That's right. We provide those free of charge.
And can I ask what goods you can transport? Like, do you take electrical goods?
Well, it depends. If you've got something like a computer, that's fine. But things like washing machines and fridges are too heavy and bulky for our service.
No, I wouldn't be taking that sort of stuff.
You can always check with us if there's anything you're not sure about including.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
was wondering about my bicycle. I suppose that would be too bulky.

00:01:08,100

No, that's fine. Though we wouldn't be able to take a motorbike.

00:01:12,320

Sure. Is there anything else you don't take?

00:01:16,340

Well, basically, the service is restricted to what one man can lift. So 40 kilograms is the maximum for each package. We do have a list of particular things we can't transport on our website, but I'll tell you the main points. So in order to comply with security regulations, we don't take any sort of liquids, and we also don't accept any type of foods. And if you provide your own containers rather than using ours, we only allow certain types.

00:01:48,500

So can I use cardboard containers?

00:01:51,400

Yes, they're okay if they're strong enough, but we won't carry things that have been packed in plastic containers. They crack and break so easily that our policy is simply not to take them.

00:02:03,380

Okay, fine.

00:02:05,320

And once I've packed everything, you can collect my things from my home and deliver them to wherever I live abroad. Is that right?

00:02:13,520

Yes. And we do have some special services. For example, we can make special arrangements to deliver on Saturdays if that's more convenient for you. Or if you're in a hurry, we have an express delivery option. There's a surcharge for these services, of course, but it's very reasonable.

00:02:33,060

Okay, I'll keep that in mind.

00:02:35,840

And what happens if the delivery can't be made for some reason? Like if I haven't finalized my accommodation, can you keep my stuff for me for a few days?

00:02:45,560

Yes, we can arrange storage, though again, there would be an extra charge for that.

00:02:51,020

Sure.

00:02:54,960

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten on page two.

00:03:05,060

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

00:03:11,640

And can you give me an idea of your prices?

00:03:14,600

Of course. Roughly how much would you want transported?

00:03:18,940

Say, for example, I had fifteen boxes and I've also got a violin. That would need packing with special care, I think.

00:03:29,180

Okay. And it would be collection in the UK?

00:03:32,900

Yes, and Sweden would be the destination.

00:03:36,760

Okay. I'll do a quick calculation. Let me just get that up on the screen.

00:03:43,440

Fifteen boxes and one special package.

00:03:47,900

Let's see.

00:03:49,640

It'd be something in the order of 575 pounds.

00:03:54,440

Right. And how would I pay that?

00:03:58,020

Well, you can pay by debit or credit card over the phone. Or if you prefer to pay in cash, you can just give it to the driver when he arrives to collect your belongings, and he'll give you a receipt.

00:04:10,060

Fine.

00:04:11,260

And at the same time, you'll need to hand over some documentation, so you'll need a copy of your passport.

00:04:18,260

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
photocopy?

00:04:19,399

That's right. So make sure you get that done in advance and have it ready with you. Then there are also some papers you'll need that we'll send you in advance so that you can get them completed in good time. The most important ones are the insurance documents. So you need to have filled in all the in-

00:04:41,060

That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
